sights.n: Hokkaido Museum of Modern Art (北海道立近代美術館)
sights.address: Kita 1-jō Nishi 17-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Hokkaido's largest art collection — over 5,000 works by Hokkaido-linked masters (Kataoka Tamako, Iwahashi Eien, Kida Kinjirō, Kanda Nisshō) — next to the Hokkaido Governor's Official Residence.

sights.n: Hakodate Tropical Botanical Garden (函館市熱帯植物園)
sights.w: A pyramid greenhouse of tropical plants at Yunokawa — famous for the Japanese macaques soaking in their own hot-spring pool from December to May.

sights.n: Noboribetsu Date Jidaimura (登別伊達時代村)
sights.w: An immersive Edo-period theme park near Noboribetsu Onsen.
